# Every file of the Amazon Redshift ODBC 2.3.1.0 MSI, from msi.py record: its File key, long name (a
# space written %20) and Directory key, marked driver, library or leave. msi.py check fails an MSI
# that holds a file not listed here or lacks one listed. The driver and library files are the
# Windows set the lock pins; the rest are left in the MSI: the samples, the setup tools, the
# configuration and trust files, the notices (the release tag's copies ship, not these), and the
# Kerberos DLLs only the GSS path loads.
# <driver|library|leave> <File key> <long name> <Directory key>
